newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to discuss Hungarocamion sale in Oct/Nov.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to discuss Hungarocamion sale in Oct/Nov.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt's board will discuss the privatisation of transport company Hungarocamion Rt late in October or early November, APV spokesman Adam Dudits said on Thursday.
"Hungarocamion's privatisation strategy is planned to be submitted to the board at the end of October or at the beginning of November," he said.

Currently APV has a 96 percent stake of Hungarocamion's 5.23 billion forint share capital. During the privatisation about 10 percent of the firm will be set aside for social security funds and another 10 percent for employees, he said.

In 1995 Hungarocamion posted a consolidated operating profit of 201 million forints on net sales of 20.23 billion, compared to an operating loss of 404 million on sales of 17.67 billion in 1994, Dudits said.
Despite swinging to an operating profit in 1995, Hungarocamion remained in the red, although it narrowed the 1.322 billion forint loss of 1994 to 573 million in 1995.
